query:
query menu($venueSlug: String!, $orderingType: OrderingType!, $categorySlug: String!, $tableNumber: String, $tableArea: String, $orderingWindowStartDate: String) {
  guestMenuCategory(
    venueSlug: $venueSlug
    categorySlug: $categorySlug
    orderingType: $orderingType
    tableArea: $tableArea
    tableNumber: $tableNumber
    orderingWindowStartDate: $orderingWindowStartDate
  ) {
    id
    name
    slug
    isWaitTimeActive
    waitTimeEstimationInMinutes
    image {
      id
      originalImagePath
      originalImageUrl
      __typename
    }
    menuSections {
      id
      name
      slug
      subSection
      isWaitTimeActive
      isUnavailable
      waitTimeEstimationInMinutes
      menuItems {
        id
        slug
        name
        type
        isAvailable(orderingWindowStartDate: $orderingWindowStartDate)
        isLive
        isPopular
        image {
          id
          originalImagePath
          originalImageUrl
          __typename
        }
        namefr
        imageCredit
        filterTags
        nameel
        namees
        nameit
        namezhCN
        namede
        description
        descriptionPlain
        descriptionfr
        descriptionel
        descriptiones
        descriptionit
        descriptionzhCN
        descriptionde
        dietaryTags
        priceData {
          displayPrice
          priceInCents
          originalPriceInCents
          originalDisplayPrice
          hasPriceOverride
          __typename
        }
        rewardPrice {
          originalAmountInCents
          originalDisplayAmount
          __typename
        }
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
  guestMenuCategories(
    venueSlug: $venueSlug
    orderingType: $orderingType
    tableArea: $tableArea
    tableNumber: $tableNumber
    orderingWindowStartDate: $orderingWindowStartDate
  ) {
    id
    name
    slug
    isClosed(
      tableArea: $tableArea
      tableNumber: $tableNumber
      orderingType: $orderingType
      orderingWindowStartDate: $orderingWindowStartDate
    )
    image {
      id
      originalImagePath
      originalImageUrl
      __typename
    }
    position
    mvoFeatured
    isWaitTimeActive
    waitTimeEstimationInMinutes
    menuSections {
      id
      name
      slug
      subSection
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}
